title: The reusable role catalogue
description: identities/roles/catalog.json: every role agent-fabric knows, by id. A role is a reusable identity — a charter, an authority boundary, a way of working — independent of any project and of any agent that happens to hold it. Where a role applies inside a managed repository is a project binding (projects/<id>/taxonomy.json), not a property of the role.

groups.description: A starting layout for Fleet Deck, the operator's console: the groups it seeds when it is first set up on a host. Only a seed: the operator arranges the deck as they like afterwards, and nothing re-applies or checks this.

id.description: The slug: names identities/roles/<id>/ and goes on the wire as ROLE.

candidate.description: True while the cluster has not yet proved it carries its own weight.

group.description: The group of `groups` a new host's Fleet Deck starts this role's agents in; a seed, never enforced.
